response.answer: Sergi Morales-Gálvez is a leading researcher focusing on linguistic domination from a republican perspective, critiquing linguistic injustice and its impact on democracy. His work aims to develop a general theory of linguistic domination. His recent publications explore the relationship between international academic mobility and linguistic domination.
